runs.title: Raporo zakozwe mbere
runs.description: Raporo zose zakozwe, n'ibyo zari zirimo. Raporo irashobora kongera gukorwa uhereye hano.
runs.caption: Raporo zakozwe mbere, iy'ubu iri imbere
runs.emptyBody: Hitamo raporo n'igihe hejuru, hanyuma ukore dosiye. Izandikwa hano.
